158: A deadly airborne virus finds its way into the USA and starts killing off people at an epidemic rate. Col. Sam Daniels' job is to stop the virus spreading from a small town, which must be quarantined, and to prevent an over reaction by the White House.

Love is here to stay... so is her family.

Not all girls want to play with dolls.

The most exciting original motion picture event of all time.

Stop worrying! HELP! is on the way!

The story of America then, told by America now.

The world is in good hands.

Unleash Your True Self. Unleash Your True Power.

Hard times and Good times. Francis and Helen.

Fairy Tale Endings Aren't What They Used To Be.

The real story that inspired the major motion picture.

Oh my God, please return my tedious everyday.

Lucien - le grand père de François

Rarity / Vice Principal Luna / Photo Finish (voice)
Adagio Dazzle / Octavia Melody (voice) / Rarity (singing voice)

Flying beast out of prehistoric skies!

There are some relationships so taboo they're irresistible.

This world is overturned in its last one second.

Self - Former Deputy Asst. Secretary of Defense for Intelligence
Self - Former White House Chief of Staff

Get ready for a lesson about the bird and the bees.

22174: A grieving couple move to a remote Irish village in the wake of their baby daughter's death. They soon take in an orphaned autistic girl, only to become involved in a series of strange occurrences.

Two of Bendender's henchmen, Slagin and Carp, board the boat and relieve John of his $20,000 at gunpoint. Captain Bounce, chasing the robber's dinghy..
22942: The gangs of Jesse James and Cole Younger join forces to rob the First National Bank in Northfield, Minnesota, but things do not go as planned.
The West the way it really was!

There are no heroes. Only rebels.

The game is about to change!
24222: At an Afghanistan refugee camp, an ex-army doctor seeks to bring children joy through cricket and soon realizes that the stakes go beyond the sport.
24478: In this twisting documentary, a mechanic tries online dating for the first time and meets a woman who takes romantic obsession to a deadly extreme.
From online stalking... to real life hell.
24734: Five high school students plans to steal University Entrance Exam booklets.

25246: Anand is an environmental activist who lives in Mumbai. A chance exchange programme takes him to Hyderabad and here, a chance encounter with Satyam results in him taking over the Janatha Garage from the latter.

The community of struggling illegal aliens in Calais

There is a place The Unexplained calls home

Every city has a breaking point.

Einstein once said, If bees die out, mankind will follow 4 years later
28318: Shifting from one pocket to another, from one man's drama to another, a lowly dollar bill, 'one buck' takes us on an odyssey through the heart of a forgotten town in Louisiana.

Princess Rudrama Devi / Prince Rudradeva Maharaja

Let's all live at the mall.

The cry was MUTINY... and the decks ran red!...

Who she was. Who she is.
